title: Help for players and Dungeon Masters
summary: Help now has a "Guide for: Players | Dungeon Masters" switch, so visitors can read the Dungeon Master guide before signing up.
items: The website's Help page opens the Dungeon Master guide; switch to the player guide with one tap.
Links can open a guide directly, for example Help with ?guide=player.
Inside the app, Help still starts on the guide for your seat, and you can switch it.
